talking_points: **Network adequacy:** 26 solo PCPs winding down in Oklahoma; 3 ZIP(s) have 2+ at once (Ardmore 73401, Tulsa 74133, Edmond 73034) — each a ~12-month drive-time compliance gap.
**Facility-fee shield:** ~4,241 Medicare patients at risk. In hospital clinics they cost 2-3x more (facility fees); Corner NPs hold them at 85-95% of physician rates.

**Auto-assignment:** thinnest-supply counties (McIntosh County, Okmulgee County, Woodward County) — where unattributed members and HEDIS gaps concentrate. Prime for auto-assignment or co-funded outreach.
**Ask:** fast-track Corner credentialing. 9 Tier-A practice(s) are top priority; ~87,600 patients across 73 at-risk practices statewide.
